messages:
Ava - People Ops: Quick heads-up — we've published a small update to the Handbook: PTO exceptions & manager review workflow. Managers need to acknowledge the change and complete a 10-min compliance micro-training by next Friday. Details + form: https://intranet.redwood/hr/handbook-update

Jamie - Eng: TL;DR — does this change carryover rules or just the exception approval flow?

Ava - People Ops: Just the exception approval flow. Carryover & accrual unchanged. New steps for managers: 1) skim the updated section, 2) submit the team exception roster via the form, 3) complete the micro-training quiz (10 mins). The form collects manager name, team, and CSV upload for exceptions.

Sophia - Manager: Can you drop a manager-facing slide deck or 1-pager I can use in my team huddle?

Ava - People Ops: Yep — manager talking points + slides here: https://drive.redwood.com/hr/pto-exceptions-slides. Use slide 3-5 for the flow.

Mike - Recruiting: How will People Ops know who finished the training? Want to sync to HRIS for audits.

people-ops-bot: Automated message — new tracker created: manager-training-completions.csv (private to People Ops).

Ava - People Ops: We'll export completion statuses weekly and provide a CSV formatted for HRIS import. CSV header we expect from managers when they submit exception rosters:
```
manager_email,team_name,employee_id,employee_name,exception_reason,exception_start,exception_end,approved_by
```
Please match these column names exactly to avoid import errors.

Luca - People Ops Intern: Quick question — for EU employees do managers follow a different form? GDPR stuff?

Ava - People Ops: Yes — EU appendix exists with region-specific fields (legal basis, local contact). See section 4 in the update: https://intranet.redwood/hr/handbook-update#eu-appendix. For EU submissions include the extra column `legal_basis` in the CSV.

Sophia - Manager: I'll collect my team's exceptions and submit by Wed morning. @Ava can you add me to the manager review queue?

Ava - People Ops: Done — added Sophia to the review queue and marked her team as high-priority. :white_check_mark:

Mike - Recruiting: Can People Ops share the weekly export schedule? We want to automate HRIS ingestion.

Ava - People Ops: We'll run exports every Monday at 08:00 PT and one manual export on Fridays for auditors. Test import scheduled Thu 2pm — I'll send calendar invites.

people-ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Test HRIS import — Thu 14:00 PT.

Jamie - Eng: Got it, thanks for the clarity.

Sophia - Manager: Submitted my CSV (just one exception). Thanks!

Ava - People Ops: Received and approved. Sending weekly export to HR team now. Thanks everyone — ping here if you hit any upload/format errors. :pray:
